summary: Submitted unchanged; validated as no_change with no effects, so the run ends with its records intact and nothing duplicated. Result: two sourced defects in hashicorp/raft's RestoreCommittedLogs path, each with an experiment-cited account whose conclusion is violated and whose defect claim is asserted, plus one source-analyzed open question still to be executed. Configuration recovery (98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0, eight receipts) establishes that with the feature enabled NewRaft advances lastApplied to the persisted commit index before the startup configuration scan, so committed configuration entries at or below that bound are never processed and the node keeps the snapshot's or an empty configuration, with observed consequences including a node that can never elect itself, a commit reported successful while the committed configuration's other voter lacked the entry, the loss written into the node's own snapshot metadata so a later restart with the feature disabled restores it, and candidacy lost while voting for healthy peers survives. Replay completion (29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-question-0, eleven receipts) establishes that the startup replay blocks indefinitely once it needs more than 128 delivered batches, because the FSM channel's only consumer starts after the replay returns and the send has no timeout, with the bound measured as 128 x MaxAppendEntries delivered batches at two batch sizes, reachability under the library's default snapshot settings, and a measured availability consequence in a three-voter group. The open question dec7dd4ba25743138e52303340152c0c-question-0 records the source analysis of InstallSnapshot propagation with its two readings, the persistent path through a stale-configuration leader's later snapshot, the compaction rule that forbids removing logs after a snapshot, and a discriminator. Three knowledge corrections are recorded with changed premises, affected uses marked and gaps answered; 54 claims across 14 receipts were verified against the observations with no discrepancy, every cited source anchor was re-checked, one internal contradiction was repaired, and the failed predecessor receipt is retained without a comparison claim. Remaining limits are structural to the in-memory harness, and with a few minutes left no citable probe was started; expiry preserves this state.
